verdict.rationale: Skills ship as plain SKILL.md markdown files in folders (e.g. skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md). The installer writes them into your repo as ordinary editable files you own, and they are MIT-licensed and documented for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. Community members also confirm reading the SKILL.md files directly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of moving the same files to a different harness and having them work unchanged.
